more_info.overview: Ammonium polyphosphate is an ammonium salt preparation of polyphosphoric acid. Its phosphate units can form chains and branched structures, and the chain length influences its water solubility and other physical properties. It can be made by reacting concentrated phosphoric acid with ammonia. This historical entry gives an emulsifying classification. The general chemical name does not identify one food-grade composition or a typical current human-food application.
more_info.origin: Chemically manufactured by reacting concentrated phosphoric acid with ammonia. The generic name covers preparations with different phosphate-chain lengths.
